title: Upgrading, Downgrading and Transferring a Crestline Summit Club Lounge Membership
content:
**C1. Upgrade.** A Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships membership may be upgraded to a higher membership during the year when the membership permits an upgrade. The member pays the new membership's annual dues less, where the membership's credit basis is prorated over the remaining months, the current dues prorated over the unused full calendar months. The amount is charged as an upgrade difference.

**C2. Renewal date.** The renewal date does not change on an upgrade.

**C3. Status.** A membership is changed only while it is active, as recorded on the membership itself.

**C4. Downgrade.** Where the membership does not permit a downgrade before the renewal date, a downgrade takes effect only at renewal.

**C5. Transfer.** A membership is never transferred to another person.

Whether an upgrade is permitted, the credit basis and whether a downgrade before the renewal date is permitted are set per membership; the annual dues are those of each membership.

## The upgrade difference, defined

The upgrade difference is the new membership's full annual dues, reduced by a credit for the current membership. Where the credit basis is prorated over the remaining months, the credit is the current membership's annual dues divided by the calendar months of the membership year and multiplied by the number of unused full calendar months left in that year. Where the credit basis is none, there is no credit and the upgrade difference is the new membership's annual dues.

### Worked figures (hypothetical amounts and dates)

Current membership dues 600 USD; new membership dues 1200 USD; membership year of 12 calendar months beginning 1 January; upgrade on 10 March; credit basis prorated over the remaining months.

| Step of the definition | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unused full calendar months (March is partly used) | April through December: 9 |
| Credit for the current dues | 600 USD divided by 12, multiplied by 9: 450 USD |
| Upgrade difference charged | 1200 USD less 450 USD: 750 USD |
| Renewal date after the upgrade | Unchanged — still 1 January of the following year |

With the same figures and a credit basis of none, the upgrade difference would be 1200 USD.

## Points of judgement

| Situation, as recorded | Outcome under these terms |
|---|---|
| Membership status grace, lapsed or cancelled | Not changed — a membership is changed only while active |
| Upgrade requested on a membership that does not permit an upgrade | No upgrade during the year |
| Downgrade requested mid-year on a membership that does not permit a downgrade before the renewal date | Takes effect only at renewal |
| Request to move the membership to another person | Never transferred |
